name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 76.2 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Saya butuh 3 tiket untuk besok pagi.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Kami berlima, termasuk 2 anak.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Nomor telepon saya adalah 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Penerbangan memakan waktu 9 jam 25 menit.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Kami berempat dan membawa 6 koper.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Kamar 214 ada di lantai dua.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Saya tiba tanggal 3 Oktober dan berangkat tanggal 9 Oktober.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: Jam berapa museum buka pada hari Minggu?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Kereta saya berangkat pukul 18:45 dari peron 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Bus terakhir berangkat pukul 23:30 malam ini.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Saya punya reservasi pukul 8 malam untuk 2 orang.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Apakah apotek buka sebelum pukul 9 pagi?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Tur dimulai pukul 14:15 dan berlangsung 3 jam.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Sarapan disajikan dari pukul 6:30 sampai 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Berapa harga kamar double untuk 3 malam?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: Harganya 45 euro, sudah termasuk pajak.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Apakah ada diskon untuk 2 dewasa dan 1 anak?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Harga tiket 12,50 euro per orang.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Bisakah saya membayar 78 euro dengan kartu?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Berapa ongkos bus bandara untuk 2 orang?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Menu hari ini 15 euro sudah termasuk minuman.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Alamatnya Calle Mayor 15, lantai tiga.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Hotel saya di Gran Vía 28, dekat metro.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Kedutaan berada di Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Tolong catat alamatnya: nomor 42, apartemen 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Titik kumpulnya di Plaza del Sol, gerbang 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Apakah ini jalan ke Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Di mana halte bus terdekat?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Belok kiri di lampu lalu lintas, lalu lurus 200 meter.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Apakah stasiun bisa dicapai dengan berjalan kaki dari hotel?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Jalur mana yang ke bandara, jalur 5 atau jalur 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Permisi, apakah ini kursi 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Bagaimana cara ke kota tua dari sini?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Museum sekitar 15 menit berjalan kaki dari alun-alun.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Tolong panggil ambulans, ada orang pingsan.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Saya kehilangan paspor dan dompet saya.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Di mana rumah sakit atau klinik terdekat?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Saya alergi kacang; apakah hidangan ini mengandung kacang?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Seseorang mencuri tas saya berisi 200 euro.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Panggil polisi, tolong. Ada kecelakaan.
